Beyondcorp Enterprise provides identity and context aware access controls
for enterprise resources and enables zero-trust access. Using the
Beyondcorp Enterprise APIs, enterprises can set up multi-cloud and on-prem
connectivity using the App Connector hybrid connectivity solution.

## Overview

Most applications use the `*Client` types in this library:

- `AppConnectionsServiceClient`: The beyondcorp.googleapis.com service implements the Google Cloud BeyondCorp API.

## Quickstart

The following example demonstrates using `AppConnectionsServiceClient`:

```swift
import Foundation
import GoogleCloudBeyondCorpAppConnectionsV1
import GoogleCloudLocation
import GoogleIAMV1
import GoogleLongRunning
import GoogleWKT

func sample(projectId: String, locationId: String, ) async throws {
  let client = try GoogleCloudBeyondCorpAppConnectionsV1.AppConnectionsServiceClient()
  let items = client.listAppConnectionsByItems(
    request: ListAppConnectionsRequest()
  .with {
    $0.parent = "projects/\(projectId)/locations/\(locationId)"
  }
)
  for try await item in items {
    print("  \(item)")
  }
}
```

## Installation

Add `swift-google-cloud-beyondcorp-appconnections-v1` as a package dependency:

```bash
swift package add-dependency https://github.com/googleapis/swift-google-cloud-beyondcorp-appconnections-v1.git --from 0.3.0
```

Then add `GoogleCloudBeyondCorpAppConnectionsV1` to your target's dependencies:

```bash
swift package add-target-dependency GoogleCloudBeyondCorpAppConnectionsV1 <target-name> --package swift-google-cloud-beyondcorp-appconnections-v1
```
